title: Best Social Media Video Editors (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a social media video editor for Reels, TikTok and Shorts: what the package should include, how to brief it, price factors and red flags.
intro: Short vertical videos for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts have to grab attention in the first second and work without sound. A good editor knows the formats, pacing and caption styles of each platform. Orders go wrong when music is not licensed for business use, or when the editor has no clear idea what the channel is about. This guide helps you brief well.

faq.q: Do I need to film the footage myself?
faq.a: Usually yes. Most editors work with footage you send, from a phone or camera. Some packages include stock footage or AI tools, and some creators film for you, which is closer to UGC.

faq.q: Can the editor turn my long videos into shorts?
faq.a: Yes, that is a common service, often called repurposing. Tell the editor which moments matter, or ask them to pick the strongest clips and add captions and hooks.
For business accounts, many popular songs are not allowed. Use music licensed for commercial use or the platform's commercial music library. Ask the editor where their music comes from.
Yes. Many people watch with the sound off. Burned-in captions make the video easier to follow and more accessible. Ask for a style that matches your brand.

faq.q: How many videos should I order?
faq.a: Short-form works best with regular posting. A monthly bundle often costs less per video and lets the editor learn your style. Start with a few to test fit first.
